name: Original Wine lower-bank staging through one ordinary forward jump; bottle remains untouched

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.1 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original wine')
 local count=Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x37f7f))
 print('WineAcquire stock='..count..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 if count>0 then print('WineAcquire aim x=0 y=0');return end
 local b=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6752a));assert(b and b:isValid(),'Original bottle missing')
 print('WineAcquire state swim='..tostring(Actor.isSwimming(self))..' water='..tostring(self.cell.waterLevel)..' mode='..tostring(camera.getMode()))
 print('WineAcquire geometry player='..tostring(self.position)..' camera='..tostring(camera.getPosition())..' bottle='..tostring(b.position)..' bbox='..tostring(b:getBoundingBox().center)..' distance='..(b.position-camera.getPosition()):length())
 local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(b:getBoundingBox().center)
 local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z);local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.025 and math.abs(pitch)<.025 then print('WineAcquire facing') end
 print(string.format('WineAcquire aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
end}}}}
